summary: Added deterministic sampling bucket harness to tests/test_scientific_optimizer.py. Added _stable_point to the module import list, a _bucket_cases() helper that uses production _stable_point to identify task keys outside the 0.01 exploration bucket and inside it (with treatment and control arm selection), plus two new tests: test_sampling_bucket_harness_documents_thresholds (asserts bucket thresholds 0.0/0.01 and arm threshold 0.5 explicitly) and test_sampling_bucket_harness_drives_prepare_task_assignment (calls prepare_task_assignment with pre-verified keys and confirms assignment.arm and assignment.policy_id). No production seam was introduced.

tests.note: 29 passed, 1 pre-existing failure (test_optimizer_api_and_cli_expose_durable_policy_crud: 403 auth env issue, present on base branch before this change)

codegraph.affected: No test files affected by the changed files.
codegraph.impact: Impact scoped to tests/test_scientific_optimizer.py only (1 affected symbol). No production code changed.
codegraph.note: Change is test-only; codegraph confirms no production code paths affected.

verification.approach: test-only change; _bucket_cases() helper uses production _stable_point to compute deterministic bucket membership; thresholds documented via sentinel assertions; end-to-end prepare_task_assignment verified for outside-bucket (no assignment), treatment-arm (assignment.arm==treatment), and control-arm (assignment.arm==control) cases
